text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Behold, gathered lords! And people of the 
realm! This is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This is the ultimateâmy 'Holy Sword'! 
HAAAAAAAAHH!!" locks": []}, {"id": 14, 
"en": "The ultimate slash... So cool! I 
knew it, 'sharpness' really is my true 
essence!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This acceleration is...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So bright! My eyes... My eyyyyes!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: All of it—for the sake of my King!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Durandal! What tremendous finishing speed! 
Has there ever been an Umamusume with such 
razor-sharp acceleration before?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She showed us an unbelievable burst of 
speed that left the fans completely 
astounded!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, I can only unleash a single 
strike. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I gave it the strongest strike I can 
possibly muster right now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... It may only be a single strike. 
Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That finishing burst isn't something you 
can create in just an instant...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Believe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I can tell. Just how much rigorous 
training went on behind the scenes...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san's "Holy Sword" is a true 
masterwork, backed by all that accumulated 
effort.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because Believe was such a hard 
worker, it seemed she understood that 
Durandal's "Holy Sword" was no half-baked 
blade.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Durandal... I've watched over you warmly 
until now, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That run... today... I might not be able 
to just smile and watch anymore.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even if I return to top form, there's no 
telling if I can win.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The knight of the neighboring kingdom is 
my greatest rival. And...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The one who deserves praise is her 
Trainer, who forged her this far without 
any hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No one doubts that talent anymore... A 
king bound by destiny to Durandal...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My final autumn is coming soon. This 
autumn, I will...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I want to compete with you. —As a fellow 
exemplar for others."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's eyes seem to speak to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking into those eyes, I realized. 
Durandal had become a knight formidable 
enough to rob even a princess of her 
composure.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I believe I was able to 
demonstrate your authority with utmost 
certainty.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No one looks down on you anymore. Everyone 
acknowledges you as the king of a great 
nation, and soon...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
They will learn that our kingdom is 
eternal.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we've gotta reach the true summit!
Yeah, we've gotta reach the true summit!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This autumn, I must demonstrate 
absolute power. To achieve that—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Winning both the Sprinters Stakes and the 
Mile Championship—consecutive victories in 
the short-distance GⅠ route!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I promise you this right now. Upon my 
sword.
choice_data_list:
Back-to-back GⅠ wins, huh... Can we pull 
it off!?

Back-to-back GⅠ wins, huh... We can do 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe our first hurdle, the 
Sprinters Stakes, should be manageable.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Princess Fine Motion will not be entering 
the sprint races. Furthermore...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san mentioned she wasn't planning 
on running either. In that case, there is 
no one who can stand in the way of my 
'Holy Sword.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without those two formidable rivals 
around, the chance of slipping up is low. 
The first race of autumn is a huge 
opportunity, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san's "Holy Sword"... If it 
continues to be polished even further from 
here on...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No Umamusume will be able to rival her 
anymore. But, if there's anyone who could 
counter that signature skill—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Likewise... one who has mastered a single 
art.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If only I could hone a completely 
different specialty to the same level...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us be on our way, Trainer-dono. Toward 
a fruitful autumn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not a dark cloud in sight. Her prospects 
heading into the Sprinters Stakes were 
looking promising, to say the least.
